prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single, objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case in Chicago — the right lawyer depends on your injuries, the facts, your goals (quick settlement vs trial), budget, and personality fit. I can, however, help you find an excellent attorney and tell you how to pick one.

How to choose
- Experience with car-accident cases and browser trial experience (important if insurer won’t offer fair value).  
- Track record: settlements/verdicts in cases like yours (similar injuries/causes).  
- Who actually handles the work (lead attorney vs junior associate).  
- Communication style and availability.  
- Fee arrangement (most PI lawyers work on contingency — you pay only if they recover money).  
- Client reviews, disciplinary history, and peer recognition (Super Lawyers, AVVO, Martindale-Hubbell).  
- Will they advance case costs and handle medical lien issues?

Reputable Chicago plaintiff firms (examples, not an endorsement)
- Clifford Law Offices  
- Corboy & Demetrio  
- Levin & Perconti  
- Power Rogers PLC  
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C.

Where to look/verify
- Illinois State Bar Association or Chicago Bar Association referral services  
- Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, AVVO for ratings and reviews  
- Local trial lawyer groups (Illinois Trial Lawyers Association)  
- Court records for past verdicts

Questions to ask in a free consult
- How many car-accident cases like mine have you handled?  
- Do you try cases or mainly settle? What percentage go to trial?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day?  
- What’s your fee and who pays costs?  
- What results have you obtained for similar cases?  
- How will you communicate updates and how often?

If you want, tell me:
- ZIP code or neighborhood, a brief summary of the crash (fault, injuries, current insurer dealings), and whether you want a firm that will definitely try the case in court. I’ll put together a tailored short list of firms/attorneys near you and a script you can use for consultations.
